_note: Adopt audit 2026-09-30. Evidence run: `dotnet test TakGame.sln` -> Transport 19/19, Core 95/95 (114 total, 0 failed). `dotnet build` of Blazor, Cli, Avalonia.Desktop -> 0 errors. `gh run list` for CI. passes=true means the named tests/CI run exercise that behaviour; nothing here was driven in a real UI or over a real relay. Milestone labels: M0 = proposed core-promise path (to be confirmed at scope); existing = built before adoption; M1/Later = proposed.

features.behaviour: Events published to a real relay are accepted: valid Nostr event signature (BIP-340 Schnorr on secp256k1) and Nostr-compatible identity keys
acceptance: Publish one signed event to a real relay and read back an OK true message
Same event fetched by a second client
features.evidence: Seen in code: NostrEvent.Sig is never assigned anywhere in src (only the property declaration matches); identity keys are Ed25519 (CryptoSigner.cs), not secp256k1. Relays following NIP-01 should reject such events (inferred, unverified against a live relay).

features.behaviour: Move payload is encrypted by the sender and decrypted by the OTHER peer (both sides derive the same shared secret)
acceptance: Test where Alice encrypts with (alicePriv, bobPub) and Bob decrypts with (bobPriv, alicePub)
features.evidence: Seen in code: Nip44Encryption.DeriveSharedSecret = SHA256(privateKey || peerPublicKey) (Nip44Encryption.cs:81-93), which is not ECDH; the two peers derive different secrets. TransportBenchmarkTests decrypts with DeriveSharedSecret(senderPriv, recipientPub), the sender's own keys on both sides, so the passing round trip never exercises a second peer. Also ChaCha20-Poly1305 with HKDF, which differs from the NIP-44 v2 spec as I know it (unverified against current spec text).

features.behaviour: A move made in client A is sent over relays and applied and verified in client B (and back), through NostrTransportClient into TakGameSession.ProcessRemoteMove
acceptance: Two processes/devices, real relay, 10 alternating moves, both show same state hash
Illegal/tampered payload injected by a test peer is dropped and flagged
features.evidence: Seen in code: SendMoveEnvelopeAsync, SubscribeIncomingMovesAsync and OnMoveEnvelopeReceived have zero call sites outside NostrTransportClient.cs; ConnectAllAsync is called only from ProfileModal.razor (kind-0 profile). TakGameSession.OnRemoteEnvelopeReady/ProcessRemoteMove are used only by tests. No test touches a relay or a fake relay.
